verdict.rationale: The evidence shows least-privilege access only indirectly. Bitbucket documents granular permissions at the workspace, project, repo, branch, environment and package level. A community user reports that Bitbucket deploy keys are read-only and can be attached to multiple repos, which is a scoped, limited credential that could serve an automated agent. Missing for 10: any evidence of scoped API tokens or access tokens with selectable permission scopes, per-repo or per-workspace token issuance, token expiry or revocation, agent-specific credential guidance, and first-party documentation (the deploy-key detail comes from an old community comment).
